title: will / won't: predictions, decisions, offers, promises
en:
will / won't + infinitive:

1. Predictions (what you think or know): I think it will be a busy year. You won't like this news. Often with I think / I don't think / probably / definitely.

2. Instant decisions: I'm thirsty — I'll have some water.

3. Offers and promises: I'll carry that for you. I won't forget, I promise.

4. Shall I / we…? for offers and suggestions: Shall I open the window?

Say I don't think it will…, not I think it won't (more natural).
ru: will / won't + глагол: прогноз (I think … will), решение в момент речи, предложение помощи, обещание. Shall I…? — предложить что-то сделать. Естественнее: I don't think it will…, чем I think it won't.

boss.situation: Reply to a colleague: make 2 offers, 1 promise and 2 predictions about the next project.
samples: I'll send you the template today.
Shall I book the meeting room?
I won't forget to invite the auditors, I promise.
I think the project will take three months.
I don't think the budget will be enough.

qs.q: A: It's cold in here. B: I ___ close the window.
I think the director ___ like your idea.
Don't worry. I ___ tell anyone.
___ I help you with your bags?
I don't think it ___ rain tomorrow.
The meeting ___ probably finish late.
What do you want? — I ___ have the soup, please.
She ___ be at the meeting — she is on holiday.
“I will help you” can be an offer.
“I think it won't rain” is more natural than “I don't think it will rain”.
qs.exp: More natural: I don't think it will rain.
qs.ru: Естественнее: I don't think it will.

qs.q: I ___ (call) you tomorrow, I promise.
You ___ (not / pass) the exam if you don't study.
___ we start the meeting now?
I'm sure you ___ (enjoy) the trip.
Wait, I ___ (get) you a chair.
I don't think prices ___ go down.
Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i think it will be a busy year

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: shall i book the meeting room

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i will send you the documents tonight

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i do not think he will come

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: they will probably finish on friday

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i promise i will not be late

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I will to call you later.”
Correct the mistake: “I think it won't be difficult.”
a: I don't think it will be difficult.
I do not think it will be difficult.
qs.exp: More natural: I don't think … will.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Will I open the window?”
Correct the mistake: “She wills be here at six.”
a: She will be here at six.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I help you with the report tomorrow, I promise.”
a: I'll help you with the report tomorrow, I promise.
I will help you with the report tomorrow, I promise.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Don't worry, I don't forget.”
a: Do not worry, I will not forget.
Don't worry, I will not forget.

qs.q: Я думаю, проект займёт три месяца.
a: I think the project will take three months.

qs.q: Я не думаю, что он придёт.
a: I don't think he will come.
I do not think he will come.

qs.q: Я отправлю тебе файл сегодня.
a: I'll send you the file today.
I will send you the file today.
I will send the file to you today.
I'll send the file to you today.

qs.q: Мне забронировать переговорную?
a: Shall I book the meeting room?
Should I book the meeting room?

qs.q: Обещаю, я не забуду.
a: I promise I will not forget.

qs.q: Цены, наверное, вырастут.
a: The prices will probably go up.

qs.q: Подожди, я помогу тебе.
Её не будет на совещании.
a: She won't be at the meeting.
She will not be at the meeting.
She won't be in the meeting.
She will not be in the meeting.
